# Historical patch fixtures

The controller v29 and local v6 files were generated by `remote_access.py`
from commit `7fdeefd`. Controller v30 and local v7 were generated from
`3160f53615a89c4cad79e8c763bd8ee31ffa9217`. Their complete generated contents
are preserved, including the old debug guards and injection helpers.

Each `*-upstream.txt` is the minimal synthetic upstream source used as its
one-time backup. The local source includes the verified VK-based `send_key`
shape. These fixtures contain no real connection secrets or application data.
Tests upgrade the historical output directly; they do not rename current markers.

Controller v31 was generated from `9e34a06` (the branch head before the display-key forwarding change).
